name: babelscribe
description: Transcribe audio and video into subtitles on your own GPU (AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, Apple) in 99 languages. Nothing is uploaded.
long_description: Ask Claude to make subtitles or a transcript from any audio/video file on your computer. babelscribe runs whisper.cpp locally on your graphics card (Vulkan / CUDA / Metal) or CPU, writes .srt / .txt next to the file, and hands the text back so Claude can proofread names, translate or summarise it. Use accurate mode for the fewest errors — it is much better for Thai and Hindi. The first run downloads the speech model (~1.6 GB).
